linkOut.hint: Opens in a new window on a site we do not control.
linkOut.empty: Add a confirmed issue tag or a forum to build research links.

notes.heading: Research notes
notes.empty: No notes yet. Write down what you found and the authorities you chose.
notes.error: Notes could not be loaded. Try again.
notes.offline: You are offline. Notes are shown read-only.
notes.denied: You do not have access to research notes.
notes.saveError: The note was not saved. Try again.
notes.pinHint: Pinning keeps an authority at the top of this note. It does not add a citation to any draft.

search.title: Find authorities
search.intro: Describe the facts. We search anonymised public judgments for the closest passages and show the filters we understood, so you can change them.
search.denied: You do not have access to research.
search.queryLabel: Describe the facts or the point of law
search.queryPlaceholder: Medical negligence with a post-operative infection and no consent for the surgery
search.error: The search could not be completed. Try again.

filters.heading: Filters
filters.hint: Changing a filter searches again with exactly your change. The facts are not re-read.
filters.none: No filters. Add one to narrow the search.
filters.inForce: governs offences from the date entered

results.heading: Authorities
results.empty: No matching authority found. Remove a filter or describe the facts differently.
results.citedBy: {count, plural, one {Cited by # judgment in the corpus} other {Cited by # judgments in the corpus}}
results.notCited: Not cited by other judgments in the corpus

answer.heading: Summary with sources
answer.unsupported: Unsupported: the quote was not found in the passage
answer.failed: The summary could not be produced. The authorities above are still valid.
answer.hint: Every quote is checked against the passage it cites. A claim that fails the check is marked unsupported.

matter.hint: Opens a search for this matter's confirmed statutes and issues. Nothing is sent until you press Search.
matter.failed: A search could not be prepared for this matter.

settingsResearch.title: Research providers
settingsResearch.description: Where research links on a matter may point. Links open in a new window; CauseDeck never fetches these sites.
settingsResearch.ownEmpty: No providers of your own yet. Add the link of a subscription you hold, such as SCC Online or Manupatra.
settingsResearch.templateHint: An https link with {q} where the query goes, for example https://www.scconline.com/search?q={q}.
settingsResearch.saveError: The provider was not saved. Check the link.
